EVERY. SINGLE. HAND.

The family is the bedrock of our society, and no attempt to erase or belittle it by the media, academia, influencers, the abortion industry, or politicians can succeed.

Gen Z is tired of soulless isolation. We’re ready to have the courage to get married and have children.

Nature is healing

One young man led a generational movement to help people worldwide healthily speak to those we disagree with & formulate our values.

The other has openly called for America's streets to "run red with capitalist blood," and while referencing his political foes to "kill those motherf***ers."

I don’t know who need to hear this today, but you deserve to be absolutely adored by a man who loves you with everything he has, not one who’s constantly sleeping with other women.

OBVIOUSLY, you are not mentally competent if you are driven to violently murder an innocent young woman in broad daylight.

That should never mean you are excused from criminal punishment to prevent this from happening again.

Just so everyone understands what just happened in Charlotte NC today:

Decarlos Brown Jr, a 14x arrested violent offender:

>M*rders Iryna Zar

When they flogged and beat Him, did she remember the first time He scraped His knee? When they drove the nails into His hands and feet, did she think back to the tiny fingers and toes that held hers so

They’re like this close 🤏🤏🤏 to understanding… and yet so far. @The View - since you all continue attacking a 28 year old with no desire for a different point of View, I’m just gonna invite all of you guys onto my show, ok?
